title: Supporting Detroit’s Next Generation of Aviation Professionals
summary: For the past 3 years, Masco’s Flight Operations team has supported the Golightly Career & Technical Center’s Flight Training and Aviation Technology course for students in the Detroit Public Schools Community District. The course focuses on careers piloting either drones or airplanes, giving first-year students hours of hands-on training to be able to earn a FAA Remote Pilot Certificate, which allows them to fly drones for profit. Select students can return for a second year focused on passing the FAA Private Pilot Written Exam, the first required step to becoming a professional pilot.
